Thank you for purchasing Blaze AI Engine!

You need to install the AI navigation package from the package manager.

As for the demos: make sure to import the tags and layers preset that comes with the asset called Tags & Layers. If you don't know how then please read the Importing Tags & Layers PDF first. This is for the demos, for your own game use whatever tags & layers you want.

Please leave your feedback on the asset page if you like the asset. It supports my work.
